decisions.reason: Adjustable quarter-pallet display meets core customer needs and has shown no negative signals, so continue supporting it.
Pegboard-back display offers distinct functionality within the core cardboard line, so keep to serve varied display requirements.
Overlaps with Product A and existing quarter-pallet displays without a unique feature, so we drop it to streamline the range.
Wooden pallet sits outside our paper-based core competency and likely underperforms, so we drop it and redirect resources to paper innovations.
Media-specific quarter-pallet serves a niche but remains within cardboard core, so we keep it while monitoring performance.
